wet_karaz_record_alliance = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      wet_karaz_order_member = yes
      NOT = {
        has_country_flag = wet_karaz_sealed
      }
    }
    set_country_flag = wet_karaz_world_alliance
    set_country_flag = wet_rei_ally_compact
    set_global_flag = wet_story_dwarf_world_alliance
  }
}
wet_karaz_measure_bloc = {
  clear_array = wet_karaz_defender_leaders
  clear_array = wet_karaz_defenders
  for_each_scope_loop = {
    array = wet_karaz_war_targets
    U04 = {
      add_to_array = {
        wet_karaz_defender_leaders = PREV
      }
    }
    if = {
      limit = {
        is_subject = yes
      }
      overlord = {
        U04 = {
          add_to_array = {
            wet_karaz_defender_leaders = PREV
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  set_variable = {
    wet_karaz_defending_manpower = 0
  }
  for_each_scope_loop = {
    array = wet_karaz_defender_leaders
    every_country = {
      limit = {
        exists = yes
        NOT = {
          tag = U04
        }
        OR = {
          tag = PREV
          is_subject_of = PREV
          is_in_faction_with = PREV
          PREV = {
            is_guaranteed_by = PREV
          }
        }
        NOT = {
          is_in_array = {
            U04.wet_karaz_defenders = THIS
          }
        }
      }
      U04 = {
        add_to_array = {
          wet_karaz_defenders = PREV
        }
        add_to_variable = {
          var = wet_karaz_defending_manpower
          value = PREV.deployed_army_manpower_k
        }
      }
    }
  }
  multiply_variable = {
    wet_karaz_defending_manpower = 1.25
  }
  clear_array = wet_karaz_defender_leaders
  clear_array = wet_karaz_defenders
}
wet_karaz_lane_G01_issue = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      NOT = {
        wet_karaz_lane_G01_secured = yes
      }
    }
    clear_array = wet_karaz_lane_G01_enemy
    if = {
      limit = {
        U09 = {
          wet_karaz_lane_G01_target = yes
        }
      }
      U09 = {
        U04 = {
          add_to_array = {
            wet_karaz_lane_G01_enemy = PREV
          }
        }
      }
    }
    else = {
      random_other_country = {
        limit = {
          wet_karaz_lane_G01_target = yes
        }
        U04 = {
          add_to_array = {
            wet_karaz_lane_G01_enemy = PREV
          }
        }
      }
    }
    for_each_scope_loop = {
      array = wet_karaz_lane_G01_enemy
      if = {
        limit = {
          NOT = {
            has_war_with = U04
          }
        }
        U04 = {
          create_wargoal = {
            type = wet_karaz_lane_G01
            target = PREV
            expire = 180
          }
          set_variable = {
            wet_karaz_lane_G01_goal_days = 180
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

wet_karaz_send_alliance = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      exists = yes
      has_government = democratic
      is_faction_leader = yes
      wet_karaz_partner = yes
      U04 = {
        has_government = democratic
        is_subject = no
        is_in_faction = no
        NOT = {
          has_country_flag = wet_karaz_sealed
        }
        wet_karaz_entry_allowed = yes
        NOT = {
          any_enemy_country = {
            is_in_faction_with = PREV.PREV
          }
        }
      }
      OR = {
        NOT = {
          OR = {
            threat
            <
            1.0
          }
        }
        AND = {
          is_in_faction_with = A01
          A01 = {
            has_government = democratic
            has_completed_focus = WET_REI_E24
            has_completed_focus = WET_REI_E14
          }
          U04 = {
            NOT = {
              OR = {
                threat
                <
                0.25
              }
            }
            wet_rei_war_veto_clear = yes
          }
        }
      }
      NOT = {
        has_country_flag = wet_karaz_offer_alliance
      }
      check_variable = {
        wet_karaz_offer_alliance_cooldown
        <
        1
      }
      U04 = {
        NOT = {
          has_country_flag = wet_karaz_pending_alliance
        }
      }
    }
    set_country_flag = wet_karaz_offer_alliance
    set_variable = {
      wet_karaz_offer_alliance_days = 30
    }
    U04 = {
      set_country_flag = wet_karaz_pending_alliance
    }
    U04 = {
      if = {
        limit = {
          NOT = {
            is_in_array = {
              wet_karaz_active_recipients = PREV
            }
          }
        }
        add_to_array = {
          wet_karaz_active_recipients = PREV
        }
      }
    }
    country_event = {
      id = wet_karaz.100
    }
  }
}

wet_karaz_prepare_vassal_weight = {
  set_variable = {
    wet_karaz_accept_weight = 20
  }
  set_variable = {
    wet_karaz_strength_test = deployed_army_manpower_k
  }
  multiply_variable = {
    wet_karaz_strength_test = 1.5
  }
  if = {
    limit = {
      U04 = {
        NOT = {
          check_variable = {
            deployed_army_manpower_k
            <
            PREV.wet_karaz_strength_test
          }
        }
      }
    }
    add_to_variable = {
      wet_karaz_accept_weight = 30
    }
  }
  if = {
    limit = {
      has_non_aggression_pact_with = U04
    }
    add_to_variable = {
      wet_karaz_accept_weight = 20
    }
  }
  if = {
    limit = {
      is_in_faction_with = U04
    }
    add_to_variable = {
      wet_karaz_accept_weight = 20
    }
  }
  if = {
    limit = {
      has_country_flag = wet_karaz_received_aid
    }
    add_to_variable = {
      wet_karaz_accept_weight = 20
    }
  }
  clamp_variable = {
    var = wet_karaz_accept_weight
    min = 20
    max = 90
  }
}

wet_karaz_select_project_site = {
  if = {
    limit = {
      state = 1
      impassable = no
      owner = {
        wet_karaz_peaceful_ally = yes
        gives_military_access_to = U04
      }
      is_fully_controlled_by = owner
      free_building_slots = {
        building = bunker
        size
        >
        0
        province = 1
      }
      OR = {
        878 = {
          owner = {
            NOT = {
              owns_state = 1
            }
          }
        }
      }
      U04 = {
        NOT = {
          has_country_flag = wet_karaz_project_selected
        }
      }
    }
    U04 = {
      set_country_flag = wet_karaz_project_selected
      set_variable = {
        wet_karaz_project_province = 1
      }
      add_to_array = {
        wet_karaz_project_state = PREV
      }
    }
    owner = {
      U04 = {
        add_to_array = {
          wet_karaz_project_owner = PREV
        }
      }
    }
  }
  if = {
    limit = {
      state = 2
      impassable = no
      owner = {
        wet_karaz_peaceful_ally = yes
        gives_military_access_to = U04
      }
      is_fully_controlled_by = owner
      free_building_slots = {
        building = bunker
        size
        >
        0
        province = 2
      }
      OR = {
        419 = {
          owner = {
            NOT = {
              owns_state = 2
            }
          }
        }
      }

wet_karaz_daily = {
  clear_array = wet_karaz_finished_recipients
  for_each_scope_loop = {
    array = wet_karaz_active_recipients
    wet_karaz_tick_recipient = yes
    if = {
      limit = {
        NOT = {
          AND = {
            OR = {
              check_variable = {
                wet_karaz_offer_alliance_cooldown
                >
                0
              }
              has_country_flag = wet_karaz_offer_alliance
              check_variable = {
                wet_karaz_offer_allied_arms_cooldown
                >
                0
              }
              has_country_flag = wet_karaz_offer_allied_arms
              check_variable = {
                wet_karaz_offer_subject_aid_cooldown
                >
                0
              }
              has_country_flag = wet_karaz_offer_subject_aid
              check_variable = {
                wet_karaz_offer_access_cooldown
                >
                0
              }
              has_country_flag = wet_karaz_offer_access
              check_variable = {
                wet_karaz_offer_vassal_cooldown
                >
                0
              }
              has_country_flag = wet_karaz_offer_vassal
              check_variable = {
                wet_karaz_offer_fort_works_cooldown
                >
                0
              }
              has_country_flag = wet_karaz_offer_fort_works
            }
          }
        }
      }
      U04 = {
        add_to_array = {
          wet_karaz_finished_recipients = PREV
        }
      }
    }
  }
  for_each_scope_loop = {
    array = wet_karaz_finished_recipients
    U04 = {
      remove_from_array = {
        wet_karaz_active_recipients = PREV
      }
    }
  }
  clear_array = wet_karaz_finished_recipients
  wet_karaz_record_alliance = yes
  if = {
    limit = {
      has_idea = wet_karaz_last_reserve
      NOT = {
        wet_karaz_sealed_active = yes
      }
    }
    remove_ideas = wet_karaz_last_reserve

        wet_karaz_lane_G01_goal_days
        >
        0
      }

      wet_karaz_lane_G01_goal_days = 1

    for_each_scope_loop = {
      array = wet_karaz_lane_G01_enemy
      if = {
        limit = {
          NOT = {
            has_war_with = U04
          }
          NOT = {
            wet_karaz_lane_G01_target = yes
          }
        }
        U04 = {
          remove_wargoal = {
            type = wet_karaz_lane_G01
            target = PREV
          }
          set_variable = {
            wet_karaz_lane_G01_goal_days = 0
